units: <cite ref="Berakhot 11a:15">Ber. 11ᵃ</cite> <he>זְקָנְךָ וכ׳</he> thy beard is &c., v. <cite ref="C00223"><he>גָּדַל</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 8:1">Snh. VIII, 1</cite> (<cite ref="Sanhedrin 68b:2">68ᵇ</cite>) <he>עד שיקיף ז׳ התחתון וכ׳</he> until he grows a beard, by which is meant the hair of the genitals &c.; a. fr.—Pl. <he>זְקָנִים</he>.
